text:
Alex K: Heads-up — I'm oncall starting 08:00 UTC tomorrow. Quick pre-shift checklist so we don't scramble: VPN, pager contact, runbook access, repo creds, and pager smoke test. Reply with ✅ when you validated each item or call out blockers.

Alex K: Runbook link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/oncall-inference (read-only for most, request perms if needed).

Maria C: ✅ VPN works from home (Wireguard profile applied). I can access staging but not prod-runbooks repo (403 on git).

Kevin L: @Maria C I'll add your deploy key — pushed now. Confirmed you should be able to git clone git@github.com:redwood/prod-runbooks.git.

Maria C: Cloned, thanks. Also heads-up: MFA reset required for a new laptop — got a recovery code but need SSO re-approve.

Samir D: PagerDuty contact check: I tested my contact method (sms -> call) earlier. If you want to test trigger, use the PD events API sample below. Only trigger in the test schedule while oncall!

Samir D: ```bash
curl -X POST "https://events.pagerduty.com/v2/enqueue" 
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" 
  -d '{"routing_key":"<TEST_INTEGRATION_KEY>","event_action":"trigger","payload":{"summary":"smoke test from slack thread","severity":"info","source":"oncall-smoke"}}'
```

Tayla P: FYI I don't have the KMS key access for decrypting prod logs. Filed an access request #infra-requests -> 1728. Need it before I take any pager handoffs that involve log retrieval.

Kevin L: @Tayla P I approved 1728. Should propagate in ~15m. Check IAM -> key-access -> "redwood-prod-logs".

Oncall Bot: :white_check_mark: PagerDuty test event received for integration <TEST_INTEGRATION_KEY> at 2025-05-03T15:12:03Z (event: e_abc123). No escalation required (test schedule).

Alex K: Quick reminder: phone numbers in case escalation needed — update your PD profile: +1-415-555-01XX. If you prefer off-hours SMS only, note it now.

Maria C: Added my cell. Also: tiny runbook update — steps 2a/2b had an old hostname. Pushed patch in the runbook repo (PR #45).

Samir D: For anyone who wants to validate SSO and 2FA quickly: go to https://idp.redwood.internal -> Sign in -> Top-right -> Active Sessions. If session persists, your tokens are good.

Tayla P: Confirmed KMS access and SSO session ok. ✅

Kevin L: I ran the local smoke that simulates a failed model load and validated the fallback routing in runtime staging. Logs in staging show expected fallback. Command I used: `make smoke-test MODEL=bert-lite` (no prod impact).

Alex K: Great — summary: Maria: VPN + repo OK, Kevin: runtime smoke + key approvals, Tayla: KMS now approved, Samir: pager test worked, Oncall Bot confirmed test. If nothing else, we good to swap tomorrow. Please ping me if any of the above regresses before 08:00 UTC. :thumbsup:
